text: In January 2021, residents reached out to my office with an urgent concern about speeding along their street and requested via an online survey that traffic calming measures (speed humps) be installed as a method of addressing these concerns. Unanimously, the residents that responded were in support of making this change. I am requesting that speed humps be installed on Ford Street from Davenport Road to St. Clair Avenue West.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Ford Street, between Davenport Road and St. Clair Avenue West. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Ford Street, between Davenport Road and St. Clair Avenue West, to install three speed humps, generally as shown on the copy of 'Drawing No. 421G-4004' dated April 2022 from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
